item.title: GraphQuon 2024 — ÉTS (Montréal)
item.description: GraphQuon (formerly MOTOGRAPH) is the annual Quebec–Ontario pre-SIGGRAPH workshop for East-Canadian computer graphics labs. The 2024 edition ran 9–10 November 2024 at École de technologie supérieure (ÉTS) in Montréal. I helped build and host the conference website at graphquon.github.io[1] so schedules, registration, and past editions stayed in one place.
